correctness.rationale: Exhaustive exact iteration of every subset of sizes one through seven verifies the complete 54-box lemma and absence of 7-classes; the four-class size sum forces (6,6,6,9). An exhaustive search of all 54-box triples and exact majority checks on complements proves the 288 total and shared-axis property. An independent 3x3 rook quotient and an explicit direct graph witness corroborate the classification. All 1296 graph automorphisms are constructed and the three complete orbits are enumerated. The included standalone executable terminates with VERIFY_OK and does not use finite-to-infinite inference.

value.rationale: The completely motivated natural extremal object is the first odd-dimensional nonbinary balanced Hamming cube, for which the maximum class count is known but optimal partition structure was not. The common-axis rigidity theorem, 3x3 rook-quotient equivalence, exact 288/6912 census and three nontrivial group orbits are a complete structural optimizer classification, not a routine application of the previously known scalar formula or an arbitrary subset census. Limitation: no higher-dimensional generalization follows.
